join: Join your voice room first (or use this command in its chat).
rate: Discord allows two renames per 10 minutes: try again later.
locked: Locked: members you permit (`/voice permit`) can still join.
protected: You cannot kick yourself, the bot or the owner of the room.
claimJoin: Join the voice room you want to claim first.
ownerOnly: {room} belongs to {owner}: only they (or the staff) can change it.
kicked: {member} is out of {room} (`/voice permit` lets them back in).
mustJoin: {member} must be in {room} to receive it.
wrongRole: {member} cannot own {room}: it is for the roles of its hub.
present: {owner} is still in {room}: ask them for `/voice transfer`.
cannotClaim: You cannot own {room}: it is for the roles of its hub.
